title.zh: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
title.en: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says

current_state.zh: Bitmine chairman Tom Lee said at Token2049 Singapore that the company will stop buying Ethereum once holdings reach 5% of circulating supply, roughly 100,000 ETH and six to seven weeks away, ending a weekly accumulation program that began in June 2025 and leaving the firm with about $4.5 billion in unrealized losses.
